publish.note: Duplicate: the 2 Stockton Street opening is carried by the SFist entry dated 2026-10-15 already on the page.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 2 STOCKTON ST → parcel 0328002; sf-parcels has blklot 0328002 active, 790–790 MARKET; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1907. EAS puts 2, 30 STOCKTON ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 2.

publish.note: Declined: a further filing on a project the timeline already follows (Fifty at First, September 2026 entries); 50 First's earlier findings are pending as a complex-not-building block.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 50 01ST ST → parcel 3708055; sf-parcels has blklot 3708055 active, 42–50 01ST; the 2025 roll records it as miscellaneous/mixed-use, built 1917. EAS puts 42, 50 01ST ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 42. The record spells the street out as FIRST; EAS holds the numbered streets as zero-padded ordinals, so this is 01ST.
